name: create_metadata_template

scope.description: Must be "enterprise". Apps cannot create global templates.

display_name.description: Display name of the template in Box UI and APIs.

template_key.description: Unique key within the enterprise; if omitted, Box derives one from display_name.

hidden.description: If true, template is API-only and not shown in the Box web app.

copy_instance_on_item_copy.description: Whether to copy metadata when a file/folder is copied.

color_id.description: Optional enum color 0–7; omit for default Yellow (0).

fields.description: Ordered field definitions (string, float, date, enum, multiSelect, or taxonomy).
